original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: ASTER GDEM/ASTGTM V2 or V3 terrain elevation is admitted, including ASTGTM_003 and ASTGTM_NC_003 plus faithful publisher mirrors. ASTGTM_NUMNC_003 attributes alone, ASTER GED, NASADEM, SRTM/SRTMGL1, ALOS AW3D30, Copernicus DEM, MERIT DEM, 3DEP and lidar-derived elevation are excluded unless ASTER GDEM elevation is also operationally processed.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: This policy identifies the ASTER GDEM product family rather than banning multi-DEM comparison. A paper may compare other elevation products, but ASTER GDEM elevation must itself be an empirical input.

anchor_repointed.reason: The seed paper operationally uses 30 m ASTER GDEM. The unified catalog already contains the authoritative NASA CMR ASTGTM_003 collection, so the former NASADEM substitute is unnecessary and observation-incompatible.
